office_does: Pacific County District Court has two judges, each elected only by the voters of its own district; this is the North District seat.
race_blurb: Uncontested: Judge Scott Harmer, elected in 2022, is the only candidate.

candidates.summary: North District Court judge since 2022 and longtime Pacific County superior court commissioner; the only candidate.
highlights: Former senior criminal deputy prosecutor and county indigent defense counsel [S1]
